items.prompt:
Summarise the following text in at most 2 sentences and at most 60 words. Your summary must include the city name, the year operations begin, and the route length.

TEXT: Meridian City council has approved a new electric bus rapid transit line after two years of debate. The 14 kilometre route will connect the northern suburbs to the harbour district, with eleven stations along the way. Construction begins in March next year and operations are scheduled to begin in 2027. Officials estimate the line will carry 40,000 passengers a day and cut car trips in the corridor by a fifth. The project budget is 310 million dollars, funded jointly by the city and the national transport ministry.

Summarise the following text in at most 2 sentences and at most 60 words. Your summary must include the number of participants, the percentage improvement, and the study duration.

TEXT: Researchers at a sleep laboratory followed 312 participants who drank coffee after midday. Over a six week period, the group that switched to decaffeinated coffee after noon reported falling asleep faster, and their measured deep sleep improved by 23% on average compared with the control group. The authors caution that the study was short and relied partly on self-reported sleep quality, and they call for a longer trial.

Summarise the following text in at most 2 sentences and at most 60 words. Your summary must include the company name, the setting where the robots were deployed, and the percentage reduction in injuries.

TEXT: Helios Robotics announced on Tuesday that its autonomous pallet-moving robots are now operating in fourteen distribution warehouses across the country. In the first year of deployment, participating warehouses reported a 40% reduction in manual-handling injuries and a modest rise in throughput. The company says the robots work alongside human staff rather than replacing them, and it plans to expand into cold-storage facilities next year.
A shop sells notebooks at $4 each. Maya buys 7 notebooks and pays with a $50 bill. How much change does she receive, in dollars? Answer with the number only.
All zorks are blue. Fenn is a zork. Is Fenn blue? Begin your answer with the word Yes or the word No, then give one short sentence of explanation.
What is the next number in the sequence 3, 6, 11, 18, 27? Answer with the number only.

items.prompt: Write a Python function `def is_palindrome(s):` that returns True if the string s reads the same forwards and backwards, ignoring case and ignoring all non-alphanumeric characters, and False otherwise. Reply with the code only, in a single python code block.
Write a Python function `def count_vowels(s):` that returns the number of vowels (a, e, i, o, u, either case) in the string s. Reply with the code only, in a single python code block.

Write a Python function `def second_largest(nums):` that returns the second largest DISTINCT value in the list of numbers nums. You may assume there are at least two distinct values. Reply with the code only, in a single python code block.

TEXT: Invoice INV-2041 from Northwind Traders dated 2026-03-14 totals $1,250.75 and is due within 30 days.

TEXT: The X200 headset weighs 240 grams, has 40 hours of battery life, and costs $89.
